title: Affected Nights Covered by the Guest's Payments on a Travel-Issue Refund
content:
# Payments operations note — affected nights a travel-issue nightly refund covers

**Rule.** How many of the affected nights the travel-issue nightly refund on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category covers depends on how the stay is paid:

- On a stay paid in monthly installments, the travel-issue nightly refund covers only the affected nights that fall inside the nights the collected installments cover, each collected installment covering the nights per monthly installment of the stay's policy (30 on Long-Term) counted from the check-in date, never beyond the stay's last night. Where none of the affected nights falls inside them, it covers none.
- On a pay-part-now stay whose balance has not been collected, it covers every affected night, the first included, at the deposit percentage of the stay's policy (50.00% on Flexible, Moderate, Limited and Firm).
- On any other stay it covers every affected night.

The collected installments are the scheduled installment collections on the stay's ledger; a collection filed as installment 0 for an alteration price increase is not one of them. The balance has been collected when the ledger shows installment 2 collected. The affected nights are the stay's nights dated on or after the date the travel issue was submitted and before the check-out date.

Policy figures: nights per monthly installment 30 on Long-Term and 0 on Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days and Super Strict 60 Days; pay-part-now deposit 0.00% on Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term, where the plan is not offered.

## Cases (hypothetical stays)

| Stay | Ledger | Request submitted | Affected nights covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| 90 nights, monthly | installment 1 collected (nights 1 to 30) | on night 21 | nights 21 to 30: 10 |
| 90 nights, monthly | installments 1 and 2 collected (nights 1 to 60) | on night 21 | nights 21 to 60: 40 |
| 90 nights, monthly | installment 1 collected | on night 35 | none |
| 10 nights, pay-part-now | balance not collected | on night 3 | 8 nights, each at 50.00% |
| 10 nights, paid in full | installment 1 collected | on night 3 | all 8 |
